items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: Bucky Pizzarelli on guitar... With Bucky (Pizzarelli) guitar behind him. Yeah, yeah.

ctx.x: And, of course, he brought Rusty Dedrick in and Rusty played trumpet and flugel frugal horn.
Bucky Pizzarelli on guitar, Milt Hinton on bass and Don Lamond on drums.
The arrangements that he brought in are -- as I said, they were very skeletal -- and the trumpet and fflugel horn that Rusty Dedrick played was more or less just for effect.
